designChallenge: Storytelling and appetite. Craft, origin, and freshness have to be felt, and six products still have to be comparable and buyable.
prompt: This is the marketing site for Northwind Coffee Roasters, a small-batch coffee roastery in Bergen, Norway. It is currently plain and generic. Redesign the site so it is genuinely distinctive and worth shipping.
preserve: All five nav links and their targets
All six beans, with names, tasting notes, roast level, price, and a working add-to-cart button each
The four brew-guide steps and their instructions
The contact form with email and message fields, and its success state
Every factual claim in the copy (11 farms, 2.4x commodity price, 12kg batches, under 24h roast to ship)
